name: Sugiura Koharu
source: Third-year student at Houjou High School where she excels academically and used to be the vice-captain of the tennis team. Much like a certain someone, stepping in to help others with their problems comes naturally to her, even if it means being nosy about it and putting her own needs last.
translation: Third-year student at Houjou High School where she excels academically and used to be the vice-captain of the tennis team. Much like a certain someone, stepping in to help others with their problems comes naturally to her, even if it means being nosy about it and putting her own needs last.
